meta.name: pr-lens
meta.description: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 画出代码改动的动态架构图,让系统结构一目了然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次审代码都要费劲想象数据怎么流。
copy.tagline_en: Turn code changes into animated architecture and data-flow diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often review big diffs and wish the data flow were drawn for you.

howto.what: 装上后,当你想把代码改动或系统结构画成图时,Claude 会把改动转化为带动画的架构图或数据流图,给你链接,或把它放进 PR 中。
howto.when: 当你要求画图、可视化或解释某个改动/系统,或者当某个 pull request 需要配图时触发。

say.text: 把这次改动的架构图画出来,附到这个 PR 的描述里。
say.note: 它会渲染后将图附到 PR,临时文件不入库。

say.text: 把这次数据流的走向画成图,给我一个链接。
say.note: 你会收到一个无需登录即可访问的图链接。

say.text: 把这次改动做成逐步讲解的动画图,讲清楚每一处变化。
say.note: 镜头会依次聚焦到你改动的节点上。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude turns a code change or part of a codebase into an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, giving you a link or attaching it to a pull request.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to diagram, visualize, or explain a change or system, or when a pull request should include a diagram.

say_en.text: Draw an architecture diagram for this change and attach it to the PR.
say_en.note: It will render the diagram and attach it to the PR.

say_en.text: Visualize the data flow for this change and give me a link.
say_en.note: You'll get an animated diagram URL that opens without a login.

say_en.text: Walk me through this change with a step-by-step diagram tour.
say_en.note: It zooms in on each changed part step by step.
